title: The top 10 songs and albums on the iTunes Store
text:
The top 10 songs and albums on the iTunes Store Posted on Friday, August 17th, 2018 By The Associated Press
iTunes charts for week ending August 16, 2018
Top Songs
1. In My Feelings, Drake
2. I Like It, Cardi B,Bad Bunny & J Balvin
3. Girls Like You (feat. Cardi B), Maroon 5
4. Barbie Dreams, Nicki Minaj
5. Better Now, Post Malone
6. Youngblood, 5 Seconds of Summer
7. Natural, Imagine Dragons
9. On My Way to You, Cody Johnson
10. Simple, Florida Georgia Line
Top Albums
3. 30 Greatest Hits, Aretha Franklin
4. The Greatest Showman, (Original...Various Artists)
5. LIFE'S A TRIP, Trippie Redd
6. Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again, (O...Cast Of "Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again")
7. ASTROWORLD, Travis Scott
8. I Hope You're Happy, Blue October
9. Scorpion, Drake
10. Mamma Mia!, (The Movie Soundtrack) Various Artists
